title: Record receipt
purpose: Transcribe the recipient's report that a dispatched shipment arrived, or was lost.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, once, while the shipment is dispatched. A recorded receipt is corrected by a manager. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Received at
items.description: Required, as the recipient reported it; repository local time, not before dispatch and not in the future. For a lost shipment, when the loss was confirmed.

items.label: Received by, Unpacked by
items.description: Received by is required: the person at the recipient's site.

items.label: Condition
items.description: Required: As expected, With discrepancies, Damaged or Lost in transit.

items.label: Refrigerant on arrival
items.description: Required: Refrigerant remaining, Refrigerant depleted, Not applicable or Not reported.

items.label: Temperature note
items.description: Optional, for example the logger reading on arrival. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Discrepancies
items.description: Required unless the condition is As expected. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Reported by
items.description: Required: Email, Signed receipt document, Phone call or Other.

items.label: Exceptions per item
items.description: Optional, one per item sent: Missing, Damaged, Arrived thawed, Does not match the manifest or Other, with a note. A note needs an outcome. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Attachment
items.description: Optional: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV, up to 10 MiB, checked by content and downloaded as a file. Do not upload consent forms, signatures or any document that identifies a participant. If the repository's storage for attached files is full, nothing is recorded.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept in the timeline. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: The receipt and its exceptions are recorded and the shipment becomes Receipt recorded (final). Nothing changes on the specimens: they are outside the repository, and the exceptions are facts on the record. If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
